title: CitizenServices - FAQ
text: Home FAQ FAQs Q1. My visit is not approved or my pass status shows under process. Ans. Pass is yet to be approved by the State Prison Department. Wait for the approval or contact the prison department directly. NOTE: Pass approval / Status and VC date time are alloted by the State Prison Department / Prison for which visit is applied for. Please contact the respective department directly in case of such issue. Q2. My Pass is approved but VC details not received. Q3. Instructions for connecting VC Q4. I am not able to connect to VC Q5.
